description: This file defines the PersistableProduct class, a Java entity representing a product with various properties such as descriptions, images, categories, related products, manufacturer, and attributes. It extends ProductEntity and implements Serializable, indicating it's a data model used for persistence.

classes.name: PersistableProduct
classes.description: A serializable Java class representing a product with descriptions, images, categories, related products, manufacturer, and attributes, used for persistence purposes.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product descriptions.

methods.description: Sets the list of product descriptions.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the list of categories associated with the product.

methods.name: getRelatedProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of related products.

methods.name: getManufacturer
